Sleek, Compact, and Portable Build

Whether you’re traveling, working, or relaxing, the Orange Fab GeekBar Pulse X 25000 provides a reliable vaping solution that fits seamlessly into your lifestyle.
Flavor Consistency from Start to Finish
Consistency is key when it comes to vaping, and the Orange Fab GeekBar PulseX 25000 delivers on all fronts. The device is built with a high-quality coil system that maintains flavor intensity throughout its lifespan. Each puff of the Orange Fab GeekBar PulseX 25000 remains rich, smooth, and enjoyable, ensuring a premium experience every time.
